search_context.feature_task: mcp-bpmn-iqf.3 MCP output schemas and structuredContent for machine-readable tool results

critical_patterns.summary: The docs/solutions/ directory is absent in this checkout, so there is no critical-patterns file to apply.

recommendations: No repository-documented institutional learnings are available for MCP output schemas, structuredContent, or API-contract parity; review against the issue acceptance criteria, the MCP SDK contract, and executable tools/list plus tools/call tests.

Treat each advertised outputSchema and its corresponding successful structuredContent as one public contract: field names, requiredness, defaults, nullability, identifiers, pagination metadata, validation issues, and XML/SVG metadata should agree exactly.

Verify compatibility and protocol boundaries explicitly: retain useful text content, keep binary or embedded SVG payloads in MCP content while exposing only safe metadata structurally, and confirm error responses remain protocol-compliant rather than being forced into success schemas.
Exercise every advertised tool through the real server boundary so schema/result parity cannot drift between tool registration, handler dispatch, and serialized responses.
